name: Elementalism
summary: Minor elemental tricks: a breeze, dust or a written word, embers and smoke, mist or water, or a shaped element.
text: Choose one of these effects within range. Beckon Air: a breeze in a 5-foot Cube ripples cloth, stirs dust and leaves, and shuts open doors and shutters, unless someone or something is holding them open. Beckon Earth: a thin layer of dust or sand covers surfaces in a 5-foot square, or a single word appears in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand. Beckon Fire: harmless embers and smoke, in a color and scent you choose, fill a 5-foot Cube; the embers can light candles, torches or lamps there, and the scent lingers for 1 minute. Beckon Water: a cool mist lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube, or 1 cup of clean water appears in an open container or on a surface and evaporates after 1 minute. Sculpt Element: dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist or water that fits in a 1-foot Cube holds a crude shape you choose (such as a creature) for 1 hour.
